entities.summary: The movement to make scientific research — publications, data, methods, and software — freely accessible to all. From the Budapest Open Access Initiative (2001) to preprint servers, open data mandates, and open-source research tools, the movement challenges traditional academic publishing and aims to accelerate scientific discovery through transparency and collaboration.
